title: The Five Daily Prayers — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Muslims pray five times daily, at Fajr before dawn, Dhuhr at midday, Asr in the afternoon, Maghrib at sunset, and Isha at night, facing Mecca. The call to prayer, the adhan, announces each prayer time from mosques. This overview edition presents The Five Daily Prayers within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Muslims pray five times daily, at Fajr before dawn, Dhuhr at midday, Asr in the afternoon, Maghrib at sunset, and Isha at night, facing Mecca. The call to prayer, the adhan, announces each prayer time from mosques.
practices: Ritual washing, called wudu, before prayer
holidays: Daily rhythm; Friday as the congregational day

example.fact: Prayer times shift daily with the sun's position.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
